subject: Request: temporary PO opt-out and vendor onboarding checklist for Velox Labs trial
messages:
From: Maya Allen <maya.allen@veloxlabs.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary PO opt-out and vendor onboarding checklist for Velox Labs trial

Hi Karthik and Priya,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Velox Labs is excited to run a short pilot of Redwood Inference for a subset of our product team. Our finance team asked whether we can avoid generating a formal PO for the first 30-day trial because we’ll be onboarding under our corporate card and invoicing will be handled via our billing alias.

Quick context: the budget is ~USD 2,800 for the pilot. We already have an executed NDA in place. To move forward I need a clear list of onboarding artifacts you need from us (tax forms, vendor profile, SOW signature, payment instructions) and any procurement approvals required on your side for a temporary no-PO experience.

I attached a draft SOW and our vendor intake spreadsheet — please confirm which fields are mandatory and whether Redwood can accept a c-card payment / invoice to billing@veloxlabs.com for the pilot.

Attachments: Velox_SOW.pdf (pdf), velox-vendor-info.xlsx (xlsx)

Appreciate a quick note on expected timelines — we’d like to start the week of Mar 16 if possible.

Thanks,
Maya Allen
Partnerships 
Velox Labs
maya.allen@veloxlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0199
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Allen <maya.allen@veloxlabs.com>
Cc: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO opt-out and vendor onboarding checklist for Velox Labs trial

Hi Maya — great to hear and glad the demo was helpful. Short answer: we can usually support a temporary no-PO path for small pilots, but procurement needs some minimal artifacts and an approval window defined.

High-level requirements from our side:
- Signed SOW (we can accept DocuSign)
- Vendor intake form (completed) with billing contact and tax info
- Estimated spend cap and trial window defined in the SOW (<= $5k and <= 30 days for the procurement exception we typically authorize)
- Billing email and payment method (c-card or invoice)

Action items I’ll take:
1) I’ll circulate your SOW to our procurement reviewer (Priya) for a conditional exception.
2) Priya — can you confirm what evidence you need to approve a temporary no-PO path and any gating questions?
3) Maya — if you can fill the vendor spreadsheet fields highlighted and sign the SOW, we’ll queue this for approval.

If procurement signs off, we’ll issue a short intake ticket to ops and schedule onboarding. Tentative timeline: 48–72 hours after we have signed SOW + vendor intake completed.

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Velox Labs — temporary PO exception evaluation

Karthik — reviewing Velox’s materials (got the SOW + vendor spreadsheet). Notes / recommended guardrails for approval: 

- Risk tier: Low (customer is VC-backed, NDA in place, pilot spend ~2.8k).
- Proposed exception: Allow no-PO for pilot up to $5,000 and up to 30 calendar days. Require signed SOW with trial dates and spend cap explicitly stated.
- Evidence checklist to attach to the procurement ticket:
  * Signed SOW (DocuSign link)
  * Completed vendor intake spreadsheet (tax ID + billing contact)
  * Confirmation of billing email and payment method (we need to know if they will supply a PO later)
  * Legal has approved the current SOW template (they sign off on terms)

Operational controls while exception is active:
- Assign chargeback label in billing system and flag spend to Finance weekly.
- Limit API key scopes to pilot-specific project and set token-level usage quotas.

If Lauren is comfortable with the low risk assessment, I recommend issuing the exception and we’ll track via a short-lived procurement ticket. I’ll prepare the ticket and include the attachments.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Maya Allen <maya.allen@veloxlabs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO opt-out and vendor onboarding checklist for Velox Labs trial

Hi all — I reviewed Priya’s assessment and the attachments. Approving a temporary procurement exception as requested with the following conditions:

- Exception window: up to 30 days from the SOW effective date.
- Spend cap: USD 5,000 firm. Any anticipated overage requires a PO and procurement re-evaluation.
- Required before onboarding: executed SOW via DocuSign, completed vendor intake sheet, and billing email confirmation (billing@veloxlabs.com).
- Finance will treat this as an invoice-only pilot and monitor spend weekly; customer should provide an invoice to billing@redwood.com for reconciliation or opt for c-card payment.

Maya — please sign the SOW and return the vendor spreadsheet with Tax ID and billing contact populated. Once I have the DocuSign receipt link and the completed intake sheet from Priya’s ticket, procurement will issue the temporary exception and ops can schedule onboarding.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Procurement (interim)
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
